jobs.occupation: Technical Procurement Manager– Utility-scale solar and BESS
jobs.description: Do you want to lead procurement for the construction of the largest solar and battery storage projects in the Nordics? We are looking for a skilled procurement professional with a strong commercial foundation and the curiosity to understand technical solutions in depth. You are willing to dig into specifications, ask questions and work closely with engineers and suppliers to make well-informed purchasing decisions in a rapidly evolving industry. Join us and be part of an ambitious team building the energy infrastructure of tomorrow.What will you do at NYAB? As our Technical Procurement Manager, you will work at the intersection of long-term sourcing strategy and practical project delivery, leading procurement for utility-scale solar and battery energy storage system (BESS) projects. Your scope will include core components and services such as solar modules, inverters, mounting systems, transformers, batteries, subcontractors and related technical solutions. In this role, you will:     Own and develop the end-to-end procurement lifecycle, from early tendering and supplier evaluation to contracting and execution.     Lead strategic and commercial negotiations to secure competitive terms, balanced risk positions and strong contractual outcomes.     Evaluate supplier offers against technical requirements, cost, quality and delivery needs, working with engineering colleagues to clarify specifications and understand trade-offs.    Stay ahead of the market by identifying new technologies, suppliers and system solutions that strengthen our renewable energy projects and make our supply chain more resilient    Drive procurement priorities against project requirements, schedules and budgets – and make sure we deliver. You will act as our internal product owner, digging into specifications, drawings and technical documentation together with the engineering team until you know the product as well as the supplier does. About you You are a goal-oriented self-starter with the persistence to follow through and make things happen. You combine sound commercial judgment with technical curiosity and a willingness to work through details, ask questions and understand what you are buying. You remain composed during complex contractual discussions and take ownership of your commitments, combining speed with precision and going the extra mile when it matters. Along the way, you build trust with colleagues, suppliers and partners.We believe you have:     A master’s degree in engineering, preferably within electrical engineering, mechanical engineering or energy systems.     At least three years of hands-on experience in large-scale procurement projects with complex technical scopes, ideally in an EPC environment.     Experience in end-to-end sourcing, supplier management and commercial or contractual negotiations.     Strong cost awareness and the ability to manage priorities within time and budget constraints.     Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.     The willingness to travel internationally to meet suppliers and partners, and to visit project sites in Sweden and abroad. It is an advantage if you have:     Experience in construction, electrical systems, renewable energy or another technically complex project environment.     Experience procuring equipment or services for solar parks, BESS or related energy infrastructure.     Excellent written and verbal communication skills in Swedish.Why work at NYAB? NYAB's greatest strength is our drive and the pride we take in our work. We all pull in the same direction – forward. We value people for their competence and initiative, and you get the freedom to act along with the accountability that comes with it. Our entrepreneurial spirit is built on collaboration and commitment. We are a close-knit community where colleagues support one another, share knowledge and work together to find solutions when new challenges arise. You will never work alone – you will have the support of colleagues and leaders, and plenty of room to grow. We also offer:    Comprehensive health assessments     Generous wellness allowance     Parental pay supplement    Reduced working hours – (Sw: arbetstidsförkortning)    A secure pension planReady to make it happen? Apply with your CV or LinkedIn profile. We review applications on an ongoing basis and look forward to hearing from you. Start: As agreed   Employment type: Full-time   Location: Hägersten, Stockholm

jobs.employer_name: H & M Hennes & Mauritz GBC AB
jobs.description: Company DescriptionAs Trade & Customs Operations Manager, you will lead and develop Trade & Customs operations across the Logistics Continent, ensuring our cross-border flows are efficient, compliant and built for future growth. You will set priorities for continent Trade operations and work closely with local Trade & Customs teams and Global Trade. The role combines strategic leadership with operational responsibility, covering import and export flows, performance, compliance, cost, risk and continuous improvement.  In this role, you will:     Lead continent Trade operations across cross-border inbound, outbound, returns and DC movement flows.     Define operational goals and priorities and lead Trade teams across the continent towards common objectives.     Work closely with local Trade & Customs teams, following up operational performance, KPIs, costs and data quality.     Own and follow up the continent Trade budget, including financial reporting, duty costs and Trade Operations-related invoice control.     Ensure compliance with import and export standards and requirements for commercial and non-commercial goods moving under customs control.     Drive operational excellence and continuous improvement, balancing cost, service levels, sustainability and end-to-end flow performance.     Lead Trade security and risk management activities across the continent.     Build strong relationships with Trade suppliers and follow up performance, compliance, agreed targets and SLAs.     Support Trade-related procurement needs and participate in procurement processes.     Act as a key Trade & Customs contact for markets across the continent.     Collaborate closely with Global Trade to strengthen compliance, performance and cross-continent synergies.     Support the establishment and development of local Trade & Customs teams as the business expands.     Stay close to end-to-end logistics performance, KPIs, operational issues and risks.     Identify opportunities to improve sustainability from social, economic and environmental perspectives.     Where applicable, oversee continent inland haulage operations from port to distribution centre.  WHO YOU’LL WORK WITH Collaboration is at the heart of this role. You will connect teams and perspectives across the Logistics Continent to create strong, compliant and efficient Trade operations. You will work closely with:     Local Trade & Customs teams     Global Trade     Continent Markets     Logistics and cross-border operations teams     Commercial and procurement stakeholders     Trade suppliers and external partners You will play an important role in connecting local, continent and global perspectives and turning them into practical priorities and actions.  WHO YOU ARE We are looking for someone who combines deep Trade & Customs expertise with strategic thinking, strong leadership and a hands-on approach to execution. We believe you have:     Deep expertise in strategic Trade processes, international trade operations and compliance.     Strong knowledge of import/export operations, Trade documentation and customs-controlled goods.     A strong strategic and analytical mindset with the ability to turn trends and future developments into clear plans and actions.     Good understanding of end-to-end logistics, particularly international shipping, procurement and vendor management.     Strong commercial understanding and experience working with budgets, operational costs and performance follow-up.     The ability to manage multiple priorities and delegate effectively in a complex environment.     Experience building productive relationships with internal and external stakeholders at different levels of seniority.     Strong people leadership skills, with the ability to plan, organize, delegate and enable teams to deliver.     Experience driving change and implementing new ways of working.     Understanding of both retail and online business needs.  And importantly, you enjoy bringing people together. You are curious, analytical and open-minded, and you know how to move between strategic direction and operational reality. You create clarity, take ownership and keep progress moving even when priorities are complex. Additional InformationThis is a full-time role and can be located in Stockholm, Madrid, Amsterdam & Warsaw. Apply by sending in your CV in English as soon as possible, but no later than 22nd November 2026. WHO WE ARE​ H&M Group is a global company of strong fashion brands and ventures. Our goal is to prove that there is no compromise between exceptional design, affordable prices, and sustainable solutions. We want to liberate fashion for the many, and our customers are at the heart of every decision we make.​ We are made up of thousands of passionate and talented colleagues united by our shared culture and values. Together, we want to use our power, our scale, and our knowledge to push the fashion industry towards a more inclusive and sustainable future. ​ WHY YOU’LL LOVE WORKING HERE ​ At H&M Group, we are proud to be a vibrant and welcoming company. We offer our employees attractive benefits with extensive development opportunities around the globe. ​     Employee discount card, usable for all H&M Group brands both in stores and online     Inclusion in the H&M Incentive Program (HIP) JOIN US​ Our uniqueness comes from a combination of many things – our inclusive and collaborative culture, our strong values, and opportunities for growth. But most of all, it’s our people who make us who we are.​ Take the next step in your career together with us. The journey starts here.​ *We are committed to a recruitment process that is fair, equitable, and based on competency. We therefore kindly ask you to not attach a cover letter in your application.

Job DescriptionHej,  Do you want to go to work and help create a better everyday life for the many people?  With us, you can feel at home at work while sharing that feeling with millions of people around the world. We encourage you to stand up for yourself and others, creating an environment where everyone feels welcome. We invite you to open new doors, embrace mistakes, and grow from them.  We are looking for a Financial Controller for IMC’s Finance Team in Älmhult.   As a Financial Controller in IKEA Marketing & Communication AB (IMC), you will have an end-to-end perspective on financial reporting, budgeting, forecasting, and performance follow-up. You will support leaders and stakeholders in financial decision-making and help drive financial awareness across the organization. Operating in a project and assignment-based environment, you will play a key role in project and portfolio financial management. Together with the Finance team, you will contribute to the development of reporting, structures, and digital solutions to support efficient financial steering. You will report to the Finance Manager and work closely with colleagues across the organization. Key Responsibilities:       Be responsible for monthly and annual P&L reporting and analysis     Lead the company’s budgeting, forecasting, and financial planning processes     Develop and continuously improve financial structures, processes, systems, and reporting to support effective decision-making with minimal administration      Drive financial steering and follow-up across the project and portfolio landscape     Act as a trusted business partner, providing financial insights, analysis, and guidance to support cost-conscious decision-making and efficient use of resources What we would like you to bring to the table  In addition to your accounting and financial controlling expertise, experience in implementing digital solutions within Finance, Accounting, and Project & Portfolio Management will be highly valued. The ability to prioritize, communicate, and provide clear directions is necessary.   The role as a financial controller we believe you have:      Good financial knowledge (University degree in Business administration or similar)       Proven experience in financial control, business analytics, and performance reporting.     Strong knowledge of Swedish accounting rules, and regulations      Strong stakeholder management and communication skills.     Experience from ERP, and Project Portfolio management (PPM) system     Leadership skills – leading yourself and leading others.   This position is placed in Älmhult, Sweden.Please note that this is a temporary position for one (1) year with the possibility of becoming a permanent contract. We welcome your application.  Additional InformationTo simplify and have good speed in the recruitment process, you apply for the role by uploading your CV (in English) in Smart Recruiters, including your answers to these two questions:   • What made you interested in this role and enticed you to apply?   • What experience do you have that you believe will be beneficial for you in this role?   Please note that we are continuously interviewing candidates and may close the ad earlier. We do not accept applications sent directly via email. We look forward to hearing from you!  If you have any questions regarding the position, please contact the hiring manager Nils Atlas, nils.atlas@inter.ikea.com For questions regarding the recruitment process, you are welcome to contact Recruiter Christina Appelqvist, +46-766-113408   We look forward to receiving your application and will be interviewed continuously, so please submit your application as soon as possible but no later than November 19th 2026. We look forward to getting to know you soon!   Through creativity, IKEA Marketing & Communication connects the heart of IKEA to the hearts and minds of the many people. We plan, produce and distribute content that enables our retail markets to grow and position IKEA as a purpose-led business and an expert in life at home. We are 300+ co-workers based in Älmhult, Sweden. As part of Inter IKEA Group, we work towards the vision of creating a better everyday life for the many people.  Your health, wellbeing, and development matter most to us, and our benefits are designed with you in mind. As a co-worker and a person, you are an essential part of our down-to-earth, playful, and inclusive culture, collaborating with others across roles, departments and even across the globe. In this curious and optimistic environment, you will find endless opportunities to grow. Make us the home of your career.

Bring more to life.Are you ready to accelerate your potential and make a real difference within life sciences, diagnostics and biotechnology? At Cytiva, one of Danaher’s 15+ operating companies, our work saves lives—and we’re all united by a shared commitment to innovate for tangible impact.You’ll thrive in a culture of belonging where you and your unique viewpoint matter. And by harnessing Danaher’s system of continuous improvement, you help turn ideas into impact – innovating at the speed of life.Working at Cytiva means being at the forefront of providing new solutions to transform human health. Our incredible customers undertake life-saving activities ranging from fundamental biological research to developing innovative vaccines, new medicines, and cell and gene therapies. At Cytiva you will be able to continuously improve yourself and us – working on challenges that truly matter with people that care for each other, our customers, and their patients. Take your next step to an altogether life-changing career.Learn about the Danaher Business System which makes everything possible.We are seeking a highly motivated Scientist to support the development of innovative scientific imaging products and analytical workflows at Cytiva. The successful candidate will contribute to the design and user validation of new products, with a strong focus on fluorescence-based applications and imaging technologies. This role requires close collaboration with multidisciplinary teams and stakeholders across international organizations.The Scientist reports to the Senior Manager, Protein Research Systems, part of the wider Protein Research R&D department, and will be an onsite role based in Uppsala, Sweden.What you'll do:    Lead and support the development of new imaging-based products and applications from concept through verification and user validation.    Design, execute, and analyse experiments, for example involving fluorescent dyes, chemiluminescence, and phosphor imaging.    Develop and optimize workflows related to electrophoresis, nucleic acid and protein analysis, and image-based quantification.    Evaluate imaging performance, sensitivity, reproducibility, and usability of new systems and applications.    Contribute to technical documentation, protocols, design reviews, and regulatory documentation as required.    Support customer and user studies to ensure products address real-world user needs, for example by leading beta-user testing.The essential requirements of the job include:    Ph.D. in Molecular Biology, Biochemistry, Biotechnology, Biomedical Engineering, Imaging Science, or a related scientific discipline.    Strong hands-on experience with fluorescence-based detection methods and fluorophores.    Experience in applications such as Western blotting, nucleic acid gel electrophoresis, fluorescence imaging, chemiluminescence detection, phosphor imaging, multiplex multi-well plate analysis, or related workflows.    Experience with quantitative image analysis, data interpretation, and statistical evaluation of imaging performance.    Demonstrated ability to independently plan and execute complex experimental studies with limited supervision.    Experience developing, testing, and validating scientific instruments, assays, or research products.    Strong communication skills with the ability to work effectively in English-speaking, cross-functional, and international teams.It would be a plus if you also possess previous experience in:    Knowledge of optical imaging systems, detector technologies (CCD, CMOS, sCMOS, PMT, SPAD, or related technologies), illumination systems, and image quality metrics is advantageous.    Experience with laboratory imaging systems such as gel documentation systems, fluorescence imagers, chemiluminescence imagers, phosphor imagers, microscopy systems, or multimode imaging platforms.    Familiarity with scientific image file formats and metadata standards (e.g., TIFF, JPEG, and other proprietary instrument formats).    Experience with user-cantered product development and usability testing.    Understanding of regulated development environments, quality systems, or design control processes.    Experience working with software-controlled instrumentation and digital image workflows.We’re looking for someone with a collaborative mindset who enjoys working across disciplines, functions and geographies. You are curious and innovative, with a genuine passion for scientific problem-solving and finding practical solutions to complex challenges. You bring a structured and detail-oriented approach to your work while remaining pragmatic and adaptable. With strong interpersonal and communication skills, you build productive relationships easily and thrive in a dynamic environment where you can manage multiple projects and priorities simultaneously.Join our winning team today. Together, we’ll accelerate the real-life impact of tomorrow’s science and technology. We partner with customers across the globe to help them solve their most complex challenges, architecting solutions that bring the power of science to life.For more information, visit www.danaher.com.

jobs.occupation: Head chef to Mr.Bronck & Sallys at Sheraton Stockholm Hotel
jobs.description: Stockholm outside, a world of guests inside, and a kitchen ready for your ideas. It´s time to bring your flavour to Sheraton Stockholm.  Sheraton Stockholm has been bringing people together in the heart of the city since 1971. Today, we’re shaping our next chapter, with a major transformation, fresh energy and new places to eat, drink and connect. With Archer Hotel Management as our operator and Marriott International as our brand family, we combine an international outlook with a strong sense of place. Now we’re looking for a Head Chef to lead the food experience at Mr. Bronck, Sally’s and our room service operation. Someone with a clear culinary point of view, a head for business and the ability to build a team people want to be part of.  From dinner at Mr. Bronck to food that complements a cocktail at Sally’s or a great meal delivered upstairs, you’ll make sure every experience feels considered, consistent and right for the setting. You’ll lead the daily a la carte kitchen operation and develop seasonal menus that give each concept its own character. Taste, presentation and timing matter equally, and you know how to deliver all three when service picks up. Behind every great service is a well-run kitchen You’ll take ownership of menu costing, purchasing, stock control and staffing, keeping quality high and food waste low. You’ll turn business forecasts into smart schedules, maintain strong food safety and HACCP routines, and keep a close eye on the financial performance of the operation. Just as importantly, you’ll recruit, coach and develop your team. You set clear expectations, share your knowledge and stay approachable under pressure. Working closely with colleagues across the hotel, you’ll help create a seamless experience for our guests. A creative chef and a grounded leaderYou bring at least five years of experience in a similar leadership role in a quality restaurant or hotel kitchen. You’re confident developing menus, leading busy services and balancing culinary ambition with commercial results. You care about the details and understand how your decisions affect the whole operation. You bring structure, curiosity and high professional standards, and you enjoy finding practical solutions when plans change. Your team can count on you for direction, support and a steady presence during a demanding service. You communicate confidently in English; Swedish is a plus. An established network within the industry is also welcome. Make your mark on our next chapterThis is an opportunity to influence the food, develop your team and help shape the next chapter of an iconic Stockholm hotel. You’ll join an international, inclusive workplace with opportunities to grow within Sheraton and the wider Marriott family, alongside access to employee hotel rates around the world. We offer a permanent, full-time position with a six-month probationary period and terms covered by a collective bargaining agreement.Are you ready to bring your ideas to the table?Send us your application. We review applications and meet candidates throughout the recruitment process, so the position may be filled before the closing date. Let’s create something worth coming back for.

Mat4Green Tech AB (M4GT) is a Chalmers University spin-out based in Gothenburg. We develop and commercialise closed-loop processes for recovering and refining metals from industrial materials, with our own lab and pilot facilities in Gothenburg. We are now looking for a chemist who will take hands-on ownership of our recycling and purification work.About the roleYou will run and develop hydrometallurgical and electrochemical processes in our lab and pilot facility, from leaching and solvent extraction to electrolysis and final purification. You plan, build and manage your own projects: you define what equipment and materials are needed, find and negotiate with suppliers, carry purchases through, and keep the work documented and safe. You work closely with our technical team and take the process forward step by step towards industrial scale.What we are looking for    A Master's degree or higher in chemistry, chemical engineering or a related field    - A solid understanding of process chemistry, including solvent extraction and electrolysis, and of safe handling of the chemicals involved    - Experience in planning, writing up and managing technical projects    - A structured and efficient way of working, with the ability to adapt when conditions change    - The ability to find, negotiate and purchase the equipment and materials needed to carry out the job    - Fluent English; Swedish is a meritWhat we offerA key role in a technically strong team with close ties to Chalmers, a high degree of ownership, and the opportunity to take a process from the lab to industrial scale.ApplicationSend your CV and a short cover letter by e-mail. Interviews are held on a rolling basis, so apply as soon as possible.

The Plant Coordinator supports the coordination and management of plant, vehicles, tools, and assets across operations in Sweden. The role supports asset management activities, lifecycle planning, and operational asset performance. The role supports plant availability, maintenance coordination, and efficient utilisation of company assets. The role works with internal stakeholders, suppliers, and service providers to support asset management, regulatory compliance, and commercial objectives.How this role lives our values This role supports the effective management of plant and assets by helping ensure that equipment, vehicles, and resources are available, maintained, and correctly managed throughout their lifecycle. By maintaining visibility of asset performance, availability, and compliance requirements, the role supports efficient operations and informed decision-making. Safety: Support a safe working environment by helping ensure assets, vehicles, equipment, and inspection requirements are managed in accordance with company and regulatory standards. Integrity: Support accuracy, accountability, and compliance through effective record management, asset tracking, and adherence to established processes. Teamwork: Build strong working relationships that support collaboration, communication, and coordinated asset management activities. Ownership: Take responsibility for following through on actions, resolving operational issues, and supporting the effective management of company assets. Sustainability: Support long-term value creation through responsible asset management, efficient utilisation, and sustainable lifecycle practices. Key ResponsibilitiesPlant & Asset Lifecycle Management:     Coordinate plant, vehicle, tool, and asset activities throughout the asset lifecycle, including receipt, return, allocation, and disposal in line with project requirements.     Support asset management strategies and asset replacement or upgrade planning. Maintenance & Compliance Coordination:     Coordinate planned and unplanned maintenance activities, inspections, testing requirements, and equipment compliance activities.     Maintain up-to-date asset records, tracking information, and compliance documentation, including leased and hired assets. Asset Operations & Procurement Support:     Coordinate plant movements, operational requirements, procurement activities, and supplier engagement.     Support commercial decision-making relating to plant acquisition, hire, utilisation, and cost management.     Support the procurement of fuel, spare parts, and other plant-related requirements. Sustainability & Asset Optimisation:     Support effective asset utilisation, reuse, sale, recycling, and sustainability initiatives in line with the company’s sustainability strategy. Fleet & Incident Coordination:     Coordinate fleet-related incidents, repairs, and recovery activities.    Coordinate vehicle maintenance requirements in line with applicable regional requirements. Health, Safety & Regulatory Compliance:     Support compliance with safety, environmental, sustainability, regulatory, and internal company requirements. Commercial Administration:     Support the effective management of plant and asset-related costs.     Reconcile monthly invoices and account statements relating to plant and assets. Key Requirements     3rd level qualification or equivalent experience in procurement, purchasing, commercial functions, or construction plant operations.     Experience in a similar position (typically 3 years or more).     Knowledge of plant and asset management.     Knowledge of Swedish regulatory requirements and construction industry standards.     Experience using asset management systems and tools.     Analytical skills, process awareness, and attention to detail.     Communication, relationship management, and stakeholder engagement skills.     Fluent English; Swedish language skills are advantageous.     Valid Swedish or EEA driver's licence.Skills     Plant and asset management knowledge.     Regulatory compliance knowledge.     Asset management systems knowledge. TECHLA is a Gothenburg-based consulting company working with modern product development across software, embedded systems, cloud and DevOps.We started TECHLA with a simple idea: to build the kind of consulting company we would want to work for ourselves. We want to build long-term relationships, work with great people and create an environment where both our consultants and our clients can thrive.We believe in transparency, trust and giving people the freedom and responsibility to grow. Our consultants should feel that they are part of something, have a real influence and are rewarded for the value they create.At TECHLA, technology matters – but people matter even more. We believe the best results come from skilled people who take ownership, work closely together and genuinely care about what they deliver.We are big enough to deliver, but small enough to care.Would you like to build digital products and services that connect vehicles, customers and the people who keep vehicles on the road?TECHLA is looking for experienced full-stack developers for assignments in automotive and connected services. You’ll work in product teams developing everything from customer-facing applications to cloud-based services and integrations.The technology stack varies by assignment. It may include React and TypeScript on the frontend, with backend services built using Java and Spring Boot, C#/.NET, Node.js, Python or Go. Teams work with cloud platforms such as AWS and Azure.What you’ll work onDepending on the assignment, you may:    Design, build and maintain frontend applications using React and TypeScript    Develop backend services, APIs and integrations    Connect user-facing applications to cloud services and distributed systems    Work with microservices and event-driven architectures    Build and operate solutions on AWS or Azure    Develop automated tests and improve CI/CD, monitoring and service reliability    Contribute to technical design, code reviews and architecture discussions    Take features from requirements and design through implementation, testing and productionWhat we’re looking for    Several years of professional full-stack development experience, typically five or more    Hands-on experience developing both frontend and backend functionality    Strong frontend skills in React and TypeScript, or comparable modern web technologies    Strong backend experience in at least one relevant stack, such as Java/Spring Boot, C#/.NET, Node.js, Python or Go    Experience building APIs, integrations or distributed applications    Experience with AWS and/or Azure    A good understanding of testing, code quality and maintainable software    The ability to collaborate with colleagues across product, design and engineering    Fluent English; Swedish is a plus.    A degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering or a related field.It’s a plus if you have    GraphQL, Kafka or other event-streaming technologies    AWS serverless services such as Lambda, API Gateway, DynamoDB or SQS    Kubernetes, Docker and CI/CD    SQL and NoSQL databases    Experience from automotive, connected vehicles, telecom or other product-focused environments    Experience operating and improving production servicesThe mindset we’re looking forFor us, being a great engineer is about more than technical skills.We’re looking for people with a strong consulting mindset – people who understand that great consulting is about creating real value, taking ownership and being someone both the team and the client can rely on.You’re highly skilled at what you do, but you’re also a doer who cares about quality. You don’t wait for someone else to solve the problem. You take initiative, move things forward and care about delivering work you can genuinely be proud of.At the same time, you genuinely enjoy working with others. You communicate openly, share knowledge, contribute to a positive team dynamic and believe that the best results are created together.You take responsibility for the bigger picture, stay solution-oriented and aren’t afraid to go the extra mile when it makes a difference. At the same time, you’re humble, genuine and enjoy working with people who challenge and support each other.In short, we’re looking for engineers who want to go beyond – technically, professionally and as part of a team.We’re open to both employment and freelance/subcontractor setups – so whether you’re looking to join TECHLA or take on your next assignment as an independent consultant, we’d love to hear from you.Feel free to reach out to johanna.bornemyr@techla.se or submit your application, and we’ll be happy to tell you more about the opportunities.

jobs.occupation: Open application - Logistic Support to World Leading Tech Company
jobs.description: This advert is published due to recurring requests for candidates within this role. It helps us build a pipeline so we can act quickly when we receive a new assignment.When we get a relevant request from a client, we will review applications from this ad and contact candidates whose profile matches the specific requirements. This also means you may not hear from us in between, as there may be no active assignment at the time.Demand for this role can change quickly, and during the summer period it may not always be active.Temp-Team Sweden AB is supporting one of the world’s leading and most recognized tech companies in recruiting Logistics/Warehouse Support staff for their Data Center in Gävle. If you are looking for a dynamic role in a high-performing environment, with opportunities to develop your skills within logistics, inventory management, and warehouse operations, this could be the right opportunity for you.You will play a vital part in making the Data Centers daily operations run smoothly. The team you will be joining covers the below responsibilities:Responsibilities:    Perform assigned Logistics/Warehouse Support tasks and escalate issues during high-volume work activity or escalation-based situations.    Seek guidance from management before proceeding with the next step of a process.    Perform data entry to document inbound and outbound packages.    Execute incoming and outgoing deliveries as instructed by management (e.g. purchase order (PO) receiving, Rack Movement Supervisor (RMS) activities).    Ensure accurate documentation of incoming and outgoing deliveries as well as records.    Perform cycle audits and data corrections to ensure all inventory controls are met.    Ensure detailed physical inventory tracking and staging.Requirements:    High School Diploma AND 6 months of experience or an internship in inventory management, retail, warehouse management, or a related field.    Basic understanding of how to use Microsoft Office applications (Outlook, Excel, Word).    Physically in good health as the role requires a lot of walking and bending.    To be considered for this role, you must hold a Swedish passport or permanent residency (PR).We can offer you:    Attractive working conditions    Employment at one of the world’s most recognizes companies who over and over is celebrated as one of the world’s greatest places to work    Work schedule is full-time    Location: Gävle    Start date: Different start date depending on the request.     Temporary ResourceApplicationYou will be employed by Temp-Team Sweden AB, but working full-time at our client’s location.We connect skilled professionals with assignments at clients that are in the forefront of their field. If this sounds interesting, send a targeted CV (in English) and we will review it and get back to you if there's a match.It is very important that you communicate your experience within the above mentioned job details and requirements in your CV.For any questions regarding the position please contact Elnaz Memarian at elm@temp-team.se

Research shows that women and other under-represented groups within our industry hesitate to apply unless they tick most boxes of a role description. At Stegra, we are building an impact company with sustainability at its core. We need a diverse, inclusive, and authentic team to rally behind our purpose of de-carbonizing hard-to-abate industries, starting with steel.So, if you are equally passionate about our purpose yet concerned that your experience doesn’t perfectly align with the qualifications stated in the job advert, we strongly encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right candidate, either for this role – or for another upcoming role in our rapidly growing business.About us:Stegra is on a mission to disrupt the global steel industry by producing green steel, with the end goal of bringing down CO2 emissions to zero. By using green hydrogen and fossil-free electricity instead of coal; water and heat will be our primary emissions. By 2030, our ambition is to produce 5 million tonnes of green steel annually in our fully integrated, digitalized, and sustainable plant in Boden, located in northern Sweden - currently in construction phase. But this is just the beginning – our expertise in green hydrogen will enable us to decarbonize other industries in addition to steel, and we look forward to what’s next in store for us.We are looking for talented, innovative, and purpose-driven people to join our rapidly growing and diverse team. Our employees get to learn everyday, implement the latest technology and test and put their ideas into practice. Together, we are building an impact company with sustainability at its core – for our people, customers, investors, society, and planet.Work location: BodenWhat you’ll doRight now, we are looking for a Project Engineer for our Project Delivery team. In this role you will work closely with our Groundworks Manager, Construction teams, EPCM Area Leads, planners, and contractors to support the delivery of civil and early works across the Boden project.As Project Engineer, you will help turn engineering packages into construction-ready scopes. You will coordinate documentation, interfaces, and execution requirements to ensure workfronts are properly prepared before being released to contractors. This is a hands-on role suited to someone who enjoys working close to both engineering and site execution.Specific to this role, the day-to-day tasks will include the following but as we are a growing company with very little silos between teams, other tasks might be included as well.    Coordinate preparation and release of groundworks scopes, ensuring drawings, quantities, and execution requirements are ready for construction    Maintain the Groundworks Scope Tracker and consolidate inputs from EPCM partners, design teams, and planners    Support forecasting and planning of upcoming groundworks activities    Coordinate scope clarifications between Engineering, Planning, Construction, and contractors    Support and maintain a structured RFI process between contractors and engineering stakeholders    Help align groundworks activities with project schedules, civil milestones, and interface dependencies    Participate in coordination meetings and support progress reporting and issue resolution    Monitor contractor readiness, access conditions, and documentation prior to site executionWhat you’ll bringYou’re curious and believe that real progress happens when we work together. You’re not afraid to challenge old ways of thinking and you treat others with respect while doing it. At Stegra, we value people who take initiative, build trust, and help create a workplace where everyone can do their best.This role is well suited to someone who has built a solid foundation in civil engineering or construction and wants to continue developing in a large-scale industrial project environment.Specific to this role, we would like to see that you can tick off a fair amount of the boxes below    Degree in Civil Engineering, Construction Management, or a related technical field    Around 3–7 years of experience from large-scale industrial, construction, or infrastructure projects    Good understanding of civil construction, design documentation, and site execution    Experience working in EPCM, contractor, or major project environments is considered an advantage    Strong coordination skills and the ability to work across multiple teams and disciplines    Familiarity with Primavera P6 or similar planning tools is considered an advantage    Experience with Swedish AMA/AB04 standards is considered a plus    Fluency in English; Swedish is considered an advantage

As Head of the Avionics & Electrical Department, you will play a central role in shaping the electrical and electronic architecture of our satellite platforms and ensuring the reliable performance of our missions. Our customers include major space companies, agencies, and commercial players across Europe and worldwide.OHB Sweden develops advanced small satellite systems for scientific and Earth observation missions. These missions require highly reliable avionics and electrical systems that form the backbone of the spacecraft, enabling power generation and distribution, communications, command and data handling, and mission operations.The Avionics & Electrical Department is responsible for the design, development, verification, and support of the satellite's electrical and electronic systems. The department currently consists of approximately 23 highly skilled engineers and specialists working in areas including:    Electrical Architecture    Electrical Power Systems (EPS)    TT&C and Communications Systems and RF Systems    EMC / EMI    Electronics Design    Radiation Engineering and EEE Component Usage    Data Handling Systems and Onboard Computers    Harness Design    FPGA Design    EGSE designThe department contributes throughout the complete spacecraft lifecycle, from early mission concepts and proposal activities, through design studies, detailed development, subsystem and system verification, launch preparation, and operational support.The space industry is evolving rapidly, driven by increased satellite autonomy, software-defined systems, miniaturized electronics, higher levels of integration, growing constellation markets, and increasing demands on cybersecurity, resilience, and manufacturability. At the same time, OHB Sweden is transitioning towards a higher degree of productization and industrialization of its satellite platforms. In this context, the Avionics & Electrical Department will play a key role in defining future platform architectures, technologies, methodologies, and engineering practices. As Head of Department, you will lead this evolution and ensure OHB Sweden remains a competitive and technically leading provider of advanced small satellite systems.As Head of the Avionics & Electrical Department, you will be mainly responsible for:    Driving staff recruitment, onboarding, and development to build a motivated and high-performing team.    Managing resource planning to balance project demands and support business growth, in close collaboration with project managers and other department heads.    Acting as a key point of contact for customers, partners, and suppliers on avionics, electrical, communications, electronics, and onboard computing matters.    Ensures that engineering processes relevant for the department activities exist and are properly implemented.    Ensures that proper engineering tools are efficiently used in the department    Owns the department ways-of-working.    Implementing strategic and operational decisions from the Company Management Team within the department.    Ensuring the department's skills and expertise align with the evolving needs of the company and its projects.    Reporting to employees and managers.    Overall responsibility for the technical deliveries from the department to the project in quality, time and cost.    Managing resource planning to balance project demands and support business growth, in close collaboration with project managers and other department heads.    Contributing to proposals by estimating costs and evaluating staffing.    Leading budgeting within your area of responsibility, covering general expenses, training, laboratories, equipment, and investments.What We're Looking For    Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Engineering Physics, or a related discipline.    At least 10 years of experience as an engineer and technical leader within avionics, electronics, electrical systems, communications, or a related field.    Proven leadership skills, with experience managing teams and coordinating complex, multidisciplinary engineering activities.    Strong understanding of spacecraft avionics and electrical systems, including electrical architectures, power systems, communications, onboard computing, electronics development and testing.    Understanding of EMC, radiation effects, reliability, and engineering standards applicable to space systems.    Strong analytical skills and the ability to foster innovation and continuous improvement within the team.    Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.    Fluency in English; knowledge of Swedish is a plus.    A collaborative mindset, with experience working in multicultural and multidisciplinary environments.What We Offer    A unique opportunity to lead one of the key engineering departments responsible for the core avionics and electrical capabilities of our satellite platforms.    Involvement in all phases of satellite projects, from early studies and proposal work to launch and operations.    A supportive and innovative work environment, with opportunities for personal and professional growth.    Competitive salary and benefits, with flexibility for work-life balance.The Head of Avionics & Electrical Department will report to the Head of Engineering & Technology and play a key role in the company's technical leadership team. This position may require occasional travel, primarily within Europe.Join us and help shape the next generation of satellite avionics and electrical systems!
